profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Currently working as a software engineer in Northern Virginia. My goals are to further my knowledge in areas within DevOps, full-stack engineering, and topics such as containerization, machine learning, and computer vision.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) - Associate
positions.description: - Collaboratively co-led a codebase reorganization effort, implementing CI/CD pipelines via GitLab CI, custom-written Docker images, and environment segregation. Using best practices, this joint approach maximized the contributions of multiple engineers, resulting in improved code reliability and maintainability, and reduced technical debt.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) - Senior Consultant
positions.description:
- Led development of a Django web app enabling real-time user network insights, remote configuration of Juniper devices used by law enforcement, and management of IPsec tunnels, enhancing operational efficiency and investigative capabilities.

- Designed a network data generation and analysis tool with Python and Netbox’s API, automating the creation of Django objects in PostgreSQL, resulting in reduction of overall manual effort by roughly 33%. This played a role in supporting a meticulously planned, FBI-wide network upgrade initiative over two years.

- Utilized Django REST framework to build out REST APIs for multiple customized Netbox instances. This allowed for efficient storage, caching, and data processing of database objects and Redis jobs.

- Applied strong collaboration and communication skills to provide training fellow engineers, deliver client presentations, and write documentation to simplify communication of technical concepts to stakeholders. This contributed to team cohesion and better understanding of project details across different audiences.

positions.title: Cloud Security Analyst – Department of Defense (DoD) - Consultant
positions.description:
- Served as a Subject Matter Expert for DoD CIO Cybersecurity Policy and Implementation Division (CPID), extensively engaging with NIST 800-43 documentation and actively participating in FedRAMP discussions to ensure secure onboarding of private cloud service providers, including industry leaders like Amazon, Microsoft, and Oracle.

- Coordinated with the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), the DoD's cloud authorization division, to facilitate discussions between policy makers. Effectively communicated and relayed insights to the lead of the CPID, enhancing strategic alignment.

- Led meetings with FedRAMP and DISA officials to support DoD's implementation of the Risk Management Framework (RMF)

positions.title: COMMS Lead, Auburn University Student Space Program
positions.description:
- Led initial design of web-based ground station interface used to communicate with a 6U cubesat satellite carrying NASA-funded research equipment.

- Responsible for training team members in Python, MySQL and GPIO board layouts.

- Facilitated conversations with space-grade radio equipment manufacturers.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · Teaching · I2C · PHP · Collaborative Problem Solving · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

company.name: Auburn University's College of Sciences and Mathematics (COSAM)

positions.title: Summer Games Intern
positions.description:
- ResponseLink: Mobile iOS and Android app for employee use in emergency situations. The app offers guidance during active shooter incidents, safe building evacuation procedures, AED location details, and medical emergency instructions tailored to employees' office locations.

- Presented the app at Booz Allen’s national Summer Games Conference to company executives and competed against teams nationwide, showcasing its effectiveness in addressing critical workplace safety scenarios.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Jest · Jira · React Native · Collaborative Problem Solving · Jenkins · Expo

positions.title: IT Intern
